text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки manages to complete the
Japanese
Derby in full. She's exhausted
by the long race,
but everyone is
inspired by her efforts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her gallant form stirs even the heart of
the
younger student, who finds herself
wanting to
keep watching Фудзи Кисэки.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Next up is the long-distance Kikuka Sho.
I worry
whether Фудзи Кисэки can handle it,
but she's full of
nothing but confidence.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Next on our schedule is the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Our race through the summer toward the
Kikuka
Sho and the strong opponents
waiting there
begins now!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
